title.narrative: To accelerate elimination of local malaria transmission and preventing re-introduction - Zanzibar (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Zanzibar, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar (Ministry of Health, Zanzibar)This program has the following goals: To accelerate elimination of local malaria trnasmission and prevent re-introduction. RSSH: To have an efficient effective and functional RSSH, capable of sustaining people centred HIV, TB and Malaria service delivery. The objectives of this program are: To protect the population by limiting trnasmission according to epidemiological and ecological setting. To detect all symptomatic and asymptomatic malaria infections in health facilities and communities. To increase the proportion of person with access to an insecticide Treated Nets (ITNs) from 79% in 2022 to 90% by 2028. To increase number of active foci receiving reactive focal IRS from 23% in 2022 to 100% in 2028. To build and strengthen the capacity of RSSH (policies, guidelines, operations, SPO's etc), and the capaacity of implementing partners (skilss, competences) to provide comprehensive and diffrentiated HIV,TB and Malaria services. To ensure availability, access and use of strategic information anddata for decision making in planning, resource allocation, and implementation of a comprehensive and quality people centred HIV,TB and Malaria services. RSSH: To build and strengthen the capacity of RSSH (policies, guidelines, operations, SOPs etc), and the capacity of implementing partners (skills, competencies) to provide comprehensive and differentiated HIV, TB and malaria.
